"""Tk widget: scrollable directory list with five policy flags per row.

A row = one directory. Five cells on the right: R / W / Id / Ip / Il.
Each cell cycles through three states:

    dot     no override at this path (inherit)
    +       override exists, this flag is True
    -       override exists, this flag is False

Click semantics (see docs/GUI_PROJECT_SETTINGS.md section 2.2):

    dot  ->  + or -   create override from effective, invert the clicked flag
    +    ->  -        flip to False (only this flag)
    -    ->  +        flip to True (only this flag)

Returning a cell to dot (removing the whole override) is a separate
Ctrl+click gesture - not implemented in this pass.

Hidden rows. A directory matched by `.patchignore` is a hard deny: all
five flags show a fixed minus and do not respond to clicks. The same
rule was in the old settings dialog (hidden = R-.W-.I-); we restore it.
An override on a hidden path (if one exists from before the pattern was
added) is ignored while the row is hidden - the file is closed anyway.

The topmost row is the virtual root, keyed "." in overrides. It holds
the default policy for the whole root; children inherit from it.

Directory rows use tree connectors (TEE, ELBOW, PIPE) so nesting is
visible without counting indents.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import tkinter as tk
from pathlib import Path

from ...config.workspace import PathPolicy, Root
from .tree import build_tree, filter_hidden


FLAG_COLUMNS = (
    ("read",       "R"),
    ("write",      "W"),
    ("index_docs", "Id"),
    ("index_py",   "Ip"),
    ("index_lua",  "Il"),
)

_MONO = ("Consolas", 10)
_BG_HOVER = "#e6e6e6"
_HIDDEN_FG = "#a02020"
_ROOT_FG = "#404040"
_STATE_GLYPH = {None: "\u00b7", True: "+", False: "\u2212"}
_STATE_FG = {None: "#888888", True: "#307030", False: "#c03030"}

_TEE = "\u251c\u2500\u2500 "
_ELBOW = "\u2514\u2500\u2500 "
_PIPE = "\u2502   "
_SPACE = "    "


class PolicyTree(tk.Frame):
    """Scrollable canvas with a scrollbar and one row per directory."""

    def __init__(self, parent, root: Root):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._root = root
        self._overrides = root.overrides  # mutate in place, same object
        self._row_widgets: dict[str, dict] = {}
        self._hidden_paths: set[str] = set()
        self._root_label = Path(root.path).name or "[root]"

        self._container = tk.Frame(self, bd=1, relief="sunken")
        self._container.pack(fill="both", expand=True)

        self._canvas = tk.Canvas(self._container, highlightthickness=0)
        self._scrollbar = tk.Scrollbar(self._container, orient="vertical",
                                       command=self._canvas.yview)
        self._inner = tk.Frame(self._canvas)
        self._inner.bind(
            "<Configure>",
            lambda e: self._canvas.configure(scrollregion=self._canvas.bbox("all")),
        )
        self._canvas.create_window((0, 0), window=self._inner, anchor="nw",
                                   tags="inner")
        self._canvas.configure(yscrollcommand=self._scrollbar.set)
        self._canvas.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)
        self._scrollbar.pack(side="right", fill="y")
        self._canvas.bind(
            "<Configure>",
            lambda e: self._canvas.itemconfigure("inner", width=e.width),
        )

    # --- public API ---------------------------------------------------

    def render(self, paths: list[tuple[str, bool]],
               show_hidden: bool = False) -> None:
        """(Re)build the visual rows from a flat [(rel, hidden)] list."""
        for w in self._inner.winfo_children():
            w.destroy()
        self._row_widgets.clear()
        self._hidden_paths = {p for p, h in paths if h}

        tree = build_tree(paths)
        if not show_hidden:
            tree = filter_hidden(tree)

        self._make_header_row()
        self._make_row(".", display_text=f"[{self._root_label}]",
                       hidden=False, root_row=True)
        self._render_children(tree, prefix="", path_prefix="")

    def overrides(self) -> dict[str, PathPolicy]:
        """Return the live overrides dict (mutated in place)."""
        return self._overrides

    # --- rendering ----------------------------------------------------

    def _bg(self) -> str:
        try:
            return self._inner.cget("bg")
        except Exception:
            return "#f0f0f0"

    def _make_header_row(self) -> None:
        row = tk.Frame(self._inner, bg=self._bg())
        row.pack(fill="x", anchor="w", pady=(0, 4))
        for _, label in FLAG_COLUMNS:
            lbl = tk.Label(row, text=label, font=_MONO, width=2,
                           bg=self._bg(), fg="#306030")
            lbl.pack(side="left", padx=(0, 2))
        tk.Label(row, text="path", font=_MONO, bg=self._bg(), fg="#306030",
                 anchor="w").pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True)

    def _render_children(self, nodes: list[dict],
                         prefix: str, path_prefix: str) -> None:
        last = len(nodes) - 1
        for i, node in enumerate(nodes):
            is_last = (i == last)
            connector = _ELBOW if is_last else _TEE
            display = prefix + connector + node["name"]
            path = (f"{path_prefix}/{node['name']}"
                    if path_prefix else node["name"])
            self._make_row(path, display_text=display,
                           hidden=bool(node.get("hidden")))
            if node.get("children"):
                cont = prefix + (_SPACE if is_last else _PIPE)
                self._render_children(node["children"], cont, path)

    def _make_row(self, rel_path: str, display_text: str,
                  hidden: bool = False, root_row: bool = False) -> None:
        bg = self._bg()
        row = tk.Frame(self._inner, bg=bg)
        row.pack(fill="x", anchor="w")

        cells = {}
        for key, _label in FLAG_COLUMNS:
            cell = tk.Label(row, text="\u00b7", font=_MONO, width=2,
                            bg=bg, fg="#888888",
                            cursor=("arrow" if hidden else "hand2"))
            cell.pack(side="left", padx=(0, 2))
            if not hidden:
                cell.bind("<Button-1>", self._cell_click(rel_path, key))
            cells[key] = cell

        fg = _HIDDEN_FG if hidden else (_ROOT_FG if root_row else "black")
        text_label = tk.Label(row, text=display_text, font=_MONO,
                              bg=bg, fg=fg, anchor="w", justify="left")
        text_label.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True)

        widgets = [row, text_label] + list(cells.values())
        row.bind("<Enter>", lambda e, ws=widgets: [w.config(bg=_BG_HOVER) for w in ws])
        row.bind("<Leave>", lambda e, ws=widgets, b=bg: [w.config(bg=b) for w in ws])

        self._row_widgets[rel_path] = {"text": text_label, **cells}
        self._refresh_row(rel_path)

    def _refresh_row(self, rel_path: str) -> None:
        widgets = self._row_widgets.get(rel_path)
        if not widgets:
            return
        for key, _label in FLAG_COLUMNS:
            state = self._flag_state(rel_path, key)
            try:
                widgets[key].config(text=_STATE_GLYPH[state],
                                    fg=_STATE_FG[state])
            except Exception:
                pass

    # --- state --------------------------------------------------------

    def _flag_state(self, rel_path: str, flag_key: str) -> bool | None:
        # Hidden = hard deny: `.patchignore` closes all five flags. The
        # same rule applied in the pre-workspace settings dialog. An
        # override carried over from before the pattern was added does
        # not open the row; the file is closed anyway.
        if rel_path in self._hidden_paths:
            return False
        pol = self._overrides.get(rel_path)
        if pol is None:
            return None
        return bool(getattr(pol, flag_key))

    def _effective(self, rel_path: str) -> PathPolicy:
        return self._root.policy_for(rel_path)

    def _cell_click(self, rel_path: str, flag_key: str):
        def handler(_event):
            self._cycle(rel_path, flag_key)
        return handler

    def _cycle(self, rel_path: str, flag_key: str) -> None:
        if rel_path in self._hidden_paths:
            return
        cur = self._overrides.get(rel_path)
        if cur is None:
            eff = self._effective(rel_path)
            new = eff.copy()
            setattr(new, flag_key, not bool(getattr(eff, flag_key)))
            self._overrides[rel_path] = new
        else:
            setattr(cur, flag_key, not bool(getattr(cur, flag_key)))
        self._refresh_row(rel_path)

"""Project settings window: name, root tabs, per-path policy.

Opened from File -> Project settings. Edits an in-memory Workspace and
writes on OK; Cancel discards.

Currently here:
  - project name (Entry, right-click or Ctrl+C to copy)
  - one tab per root, each with a PolicyTree
  - Add root / Remove root
  - Show hidden toggle
  - legend below the tabs
  - OK / Cancel

Deferred (see docs/GUI_PROJECT_SETTINGS.md):
  - .patchignore / .mcpignore editors
  - index / MCP / exec toggles
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk
from pathlib import Path

import pyperclip

from ...config import patchignore as _pi
from ...config.loader import scan_subdirs
from ...config import workspace as ws_mod
from ..projects import load_workspace, save_workspace
from .tree_view import PolicyTree


_MAX_DEPTH = 3


_LEGEND = (
    "R = read (читать)   W = write (писать)   "
    "Id = index docs (.md)   Ip = index py (.py)   Il = index lua (.luau)\n"
    "\u00b7 inherit   + allow   \u2212 deny   "
    "Click cycles the cell; the topmost [root] row sets the root's default policy."
)


def _make_copyable_entry(entry: tk.Entry) -> None:
    """Right-click menu + layout-independent Ctrl+C / Ctrl+A on an Entry.

    Tk binds <<Copy>> to the keysym 'c' (Latin). On a Russian keyboard
    layout the physical C key produces Cyrillic 'с' (keysym
    Cyrillic_es), so the default binding does not fire. We add an
    explicit handler on Control-KeyPress keyed on the physical keycode
    (which is layout-independent on Windows) and generate the virtual
    <<Copy>> event ourselves. Same for Ctrl+A / select-all.
    """
    menu = tk.Menu(entry, tearoff=0)
    menu.add_command(label="\u041a\u043e\u043f\u0438\u0440\u043e\u0432\u0430\u0442\u044c",
                     command=lambda: pyperclip.copy(entry.get()))

    def _show(event):
        try:
            menu.tk_popup(event.x_root, event.y_root)
        finally:
            menu.grab_release()
    entry.bind("<Button-3>", _show)

    _COPY_KEYCODES = {67}    # physical C on Windows
    _SELECT_ALL_KEYCODES = {65}   # physical A on Windows
    _COPY_KEYSYMS = {"c", "cyrillic_es"}
    _SELECT_ALL_KEYSYMS = {"a", "cyrillic_ef"}

    def _ctrl(event):
        kc = getattr(event, "keycode", None)
        ks = (event.keysym or "").lower()
        if kc in _COPY_KEYCODES or ks in _COPY_KEYSYMS:
            try:
                entry.event_generate("<<Copy>>")
            except Exception:
                pyperclip.copy(entry.get())
            return "break"
        if kc in _SELECT_ALL_KEYCODES or ks in _SELECT_ALL_KEYSYMS:
            entry.select_range(0, "end")
            entry.icursor("end")
            return "break"
        return None

    entry.bind("<Control-KeyPress>", _ctrl, add="+")


def open_project_settings(parent, project_dir: Path,
                          state_subdir: str,
                          on_save=None) -> None:
    """Open the modal settings window.

    Raises `projects.NotAProject` if the folder has no workspace.json.
    `on_save` is called after a successful save with the new name (or
    None if unchanged) - the caller restarts the session there.
    """
    w = load_workspace(project_dir, state_subdir)
    state_dir = project_dir / state_subdir

    dlg = tk.Toplevel(parent)
    dlg.title("Project settings")
    dlg.transient(parent)
    dlg.grab_set()
    dlg.geometry("700x560")
    dlg.minsize(600, 460)

    main = tk.Frame(dlg, padx=12, pady=12)
    main.pack(fill="both", expand=True)

    # --- name ---------------------------------------------------------
    name_row = tk.Frame(main)
    name_row.pack(fill="x", pady=(0, 6))
    tk.Label(name_row, text="Project name:").pack(side="left")
    name_var = tk.StringVar(value=w.name)
    name_entry = tk.Entry(name_row, textvariable=name_var)
    name_entry.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=(8, 0))
    _make_copyable_entry(name_entry)

    tk.Label(main, text=f"Folder: {project_dir}", anchor="w",
             fg="#666").pack(fill="x")

    # --- tabs ---------------------------------------------------------
    tk.Label(main, text="Roots:", anchor="w").pack(fill="x", pady=(10, 2))

    nb = ttk.Notebook(main)
    nb.pack(fill="both", expand=True)

    show_hidden_var = tk.BooleanVar(value=False)
    tree_widgets: dict[str, PolicyTree] = {}

    def _patterns():
        return _pi.read(state_dir)

    def _render_tab(name: str) -> None:
        pt = tree_widgets.get(name)
        root_obj = w.roots.get(name)
        if pt is None or root_obj is None:
            return
        try:
            dirs = scan_subdirs(
                Path(root_obj.path),
                max_depth=_MAX_DEPTH,
                patterns=_patterns(),
                show_hidden=bool(show_hidden_var.get()),
            )
        except Exception:
            dirs = []
        pt.render(dirs, show_hidden=bool(show_hidden_var.get()))

    def _rebuild_tabs() -> None:
        for tab_id in nb.tabs():
            nb.forget(tab_id)
        tree_widgets.clear()
        for name in w.root_names():
            root_obj = w.roots[name]
            tab = tk.Frame(nb)
            pt = PolicyTree(tab, root_obj)
            pt.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
            tree_widgets[name] = pt
            nb.add(tab, text=name)
        for name in w.root_names():
            _render_tab(name)

    def _on_show_hidden():
        for name in w.root_names():
            _render_tab(name)
    show_hidden_var.trace_add("write", lambda *_: _on_show_hidden())

    _rebuild_tabs()

    # --- controls row -------------------------------------------------
    ctrl = tk.Frame(main)
    ctrl.pack(fill="x", pady=(8, 0))

    def _add_root() -> None:
        folder = filedialog.askdirectory(title="Root folder", parent=dlg)
        if not folder:
            return
        try:
            ws_mod.add_root(w, folder)
        except ValueError as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Cannot add root", str(e), parent=dlg)
            return
        _rebuild_tabs()
        try:
            nb.select(len(nb.tabs()) - 1)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _remove_root() -> None:
        try:
            idx = nb.index(nb.select())
        except Exception:
            return
        if idx < 0:
            return
        name = nb.tab(idx, "text")
        if not messagebox.askyesno(
                "Remove root",
                f"Remove root {name!r} from this project?\n"
                "Files on disk are not touched.",
                parent=dlg):
            return
        w.roots.pop(name, None)
        _rebuild_tabs()

    tk.Button(ctrl, text="Add root\u2026", command=_add_root).pack(side="left")
    tk.Button(ctrl, text="Remove root", command=_remove_root).pack(
        side="left", padx=(6, 0))
    tk.Checkbutton(ctrl, text="Show hidden", variable=show_hidden_var).pack(
        side="right")

    # --- legend -------------------------------------------------------
    legend = tk.Label(main, text=_LEGEND, anchor="w", justify="left",
                      fg="#666", font=("Consolas", 9))
    legend.pack(fill="x", pady=(8, 0))

    # --- buttons ------------------------------------------------------
    btn_row = tk.Frame(main)
    btn_row.pack(fill="x", pady=(10, 0))

    def _ok() -> None:
        new_name = name_var.get().strip()
        if new_name and new_name != w.name:
            w.name = new_name
        try:
            save_workspace(project_dir, w, state_subdir)
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", str(e), parent=dlg)
            return
        dlg.destroy()
        if on_save is not None:
            try:
                on_save(new_name or None)
            except Exception:
                pass

    tk.Button(btn_row, text="OK", command=_ok, width=10).pack(side="right")
    tk.Button(btn_row, text="Cancel", command=dlg.destroy, width=10).pack(
        side="right", padx=(0, 6))
